reason: A how-to question fully answered by F03 on shift swapping; no always-human rule applies and the customer is on Basis, which includes this feature.
replyEn:
Hello,

Employees can swap shifts with each other: the employee opens the shift in the app and taps "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager then approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default; you can turn it off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Kind regards,
Team Roosterly
